name: METFORMIN 500 MG 60 EXTENDED-RELEASE TABLETS
description: Metformin 500 mg in a 60-tablet presentation is one of the most common doses for initiating treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus or for managing prediabetes and polycystic ovary syndrome (off-label use). Product Information Purpose: Improves the body’s response to insulin and reduces the amount of sugar the liver produces and the intestines absorb. Variants: Available in immediate-release or extended-release (ER/ER) tablets, the latter designed to reduce digestive side effects. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
